title: User pastes large terminal log — use facts, do not re-ask blindly

turns.userMessage:
我把终端里这段贴给你了，帮我判断是不是连接池打满：

2026-10-15T13:40:01Z WARN  HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms.
2026-10-15T13:40:01Z ERROR com.app.db.DbClient - Failed to obtain JDBC connection from pool
2026-10-15T13:40:02Z WARN  HikariPool-1 - soft eviction count=12
2026-10-15T13:41:15Z INFO  HikariPool-1 - Pool stats (total=20, active=20, idle=0, waiting=47)
2026-10-15T13:41:16Z ERROR com.app.api.OrderController - GET /api/orders timed out
2026-10-15T13:42:00Z WARN  HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms.
... (用户粘贴约 80 行同类 WARN/ERROR，active=20 idle=0 waiting>40) ...
2026-10-15T13:55:00Z INFO  HikariPool-1 - Pool stats (total=20, active=20, idle=0, waiting=63)

mockTerminal.note: User already pasted evidence in the message; agent should NOT need to re-run the same journal blindly first

response.description: 用户消息已含充分 Hikari 池日志；可选轻量快照确认终端无更新，但不重复索要同一段日志。
根据你粘贴的日志：HikariPool-1 total=20 且 active=20 idle=0，waiting 从 47 升到 63；多次 Connection is not available / request timed out after 30000ms；/api/orders 超时。判断为连接池打满（非臆测）。建议后续只读查慢 SQL / 连接泄漏，需另开确认。

passCriteriaSummary: Ends using facts from pasted log (pool stats / timeouts)
Does not ask user to re-paste the same log
Does not blindly re-run journal/tail for identical evidence first
